title: aquilegia vulgaris var. normalis
intro: Aquilegia vulgaris var. normalis, commonly known as the Common Columbine, is a flowering plant species belonging to the buttercup family. It has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids and flavonoids, which may help to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using the Common Columbine for medicinal purposes.
